description: This file defines API routes for managing roles within an RBAC system using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for creating, listing, retrieving, updating, deleting roles, and assigning/removing permissions to/from roles. It also integrates with a SQLAlchemy ORM for database operations and performs authorization checks via dependencies.

classes.name: RoleUpdate
classes.description: Data model for updating a role's name and description.

methods.description: Endpoint to create a new role within the caller's organization.
